commit_message: Reapply ADR0154 foundation on current main
pr_title: Implement ADR 0154 target-aware animation motion binding
pr_body:
Rebuilds the ADR 0154 first-release implementation from current main after the previous Draft PR became stale. This request reapplies the shared target-aware planner, logical Humanoid identity/provenance foundation, Animation Set schema v3 candidate-only persistence, Scene Bridge routing, Play preflight, runtime debug evidence, candidate-only picker, and package reachability changes through canonical current-main preflight.

This supersedes the stale implementation branch only after validation; the PR remains Draft and must not be merged automatically.
